description: Google Search API: Google Trends interest over time. Search interest over time for up to 5 keywords compared, as Google Trends charts it: one point per hour, day, week or month depending on the range, each keyword's value from 0 to 100 relative to the highest point of the chart. The last point can be `partial` (still being counted). `no_data` is true when Google has too little data. Price: 3 credits per call; failed calls are free.

category.description: Google Trends category id (0 = all categories)

from_date.description: Custom range start (YYYY-MM-DD, from 2004-01-01; with `to_date`, not with `time_range`)

geo.description: Country (`US`) or region (`US-CA`); worldwide when left out

keywords.description: Up to 5 keywords to compare, separated by commas

property.description: Which Google search: web, image, news, YouTube or Shopping

name: google_trends_interest_over_time
title: Google Trends interest over time
